name: Troubles
overview: Scripture teaches that troubles and trials are an inevitable part of the Christian experience, yet believers are assured of God's attentive care and deliverance, as the righteous cry out and the Lord hears them (Psalms 34:17). Jesus encourages His followers to find peace in Him despite tribulation in the world, reminding them that He has overcome it (John 16:33). Furthermore, God promises to supply every need through Christ Jesus (Philippians 4:19), and those who endure temptation and trials faithfully will receive the crown of life, a reward for those who love Him (James 1:12). This truth applies broadly, including challenges such as marriage troubles, highlighting the sustaining power of God's grace in all difficulties.
